subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: Game code and the demo family build -O4 with peephole off. OS.c, __ppc_eabi_init, and the gx library additionally need `#pragma peephole off`; MetroTRK needs `-pool off`; si/exi need `-inline auto,level=1`. Peephole-ON tells: mr-vs-addi moves, missing branch-to-next stubs, lwzu/rlwimi fusion, stw pairs where the target has stmw. Never leave an unscoped `#pragma peephole off` mid-TU: it poisons every later function.
